title: Steamed Broccoli with Lemon
summary: Broccoli florets and peeled stalk steamed for 4-5 min until bright green and just tender, salted and served with lemon.

ingredients.item: fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare the broccoli
steps.text: Cut the florets away where their stems meet the main stalk. Trim off the woody base, peel away the tough outer 3 mm of the stalk and slice it into bite-sized pieces; split any large florets so everything cooks at the same rate.

steps.title: Steam until just tender
steps.text: Bring about 2.5 cm of water to the boil in the pan, set the broccoli in the steamer basket above it and cover. After 4-5 min the florets should be vivid green and a knife should slip into a stalk piece with slight resistance. Steam cooks gently and evenly, so the florets stay firm rather than waterlogged.

steps.title: Season and serve
steps.text: Lift the broccoli out straight away so it stops cooking, then sprinkle with the salt. Serve on a warm plate with lemon wedges for squeezing; the acid brightens the flavour, but add it at the table, as it dulls the green colour if it sits.

tips: Overcooking is the main mistake: broccoli turns olive-drab and sulphurous within a couple of minutes, so start checking at 4 min.
Do not throw away the stalk; peeled, it is sweet and tender.
Keep the water below the basket so the broccoli steams rather than boils.
Drizzle with good olive oil or melted butter if you like.
storage: Best eaten straight away. Refrigerate leftovers covered up to 3 days and reheat briefly in a steamer or microwave until piping hot (74 °C), or eat cold in salads. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
